source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of Pylon Salvage-Legion painted highway-sign armour lames: sun-baked red-oxide primer steel (#8c3826) and gunmetal (#464a50) painted in sand-abraded Imperial Sun-Orange (#e07a2a), saffron (#e3a02e), and chalk-white (#e6dfd3) with horizontal diagonal highway hazard-chevron bands flanking Roman winged lightning-bolts and Sun-Orb cohort roundels (no readable text), fine desert sand-scratches and pop-rivet heads along lame seams; four roundels across and two bands down, unbroken at edges. Full colour.
